$comment: Entry schema for contributes.aiPrompts (declarative and process plugins). Host validation lives in backend/plugin/contrib_ai_prompts.go. Each entry has exactly one of template (prompt only) or path (a .md file in prompts/, skills/ or assets/). Text must be UTF-8 without control, bidirectional-override or zero-width characters; prompt templates may only use {{selection}}, {{file}} and {{language}}; a leading --- frontmatter block in a Markdown file is stripped and ignored (it cannot grant tools). Prompts expand into the AI input draft and are never sent automatically; skills are used only when the user names them with /skill.
description: AI prompt templates and skills offered in the AI composer.

kind.description: prompt: template expanded into the input draft. skill: Markdown guidance used on explicit /skill (description required).

path.description: Package-relative Markdown file, for example prompts/review.md or skills/sql-tuning.md.
